eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Colorado; at 6:58 AM on AUG 15, 2021 Effective until 9:58 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Colorado Bureau of Investigation with and AMBER Child Abduction Alert. We have received this important announcement regarding an abducted Child in Grand Junction, Mesa County. The Mesa County Sheriff's Office is searching for twelve year old Audra Hadrath, last seen in the two hundred block of Village Lane in Grand Junction, Colorado about one this morning. Audra Hadrath is described as a white female, five feet four inches, one hundred nineteen pounds, with blonde hair and hazel eyes.  Audra Hadrath was last seen wearing a white t-shirt and gray shorts. Investigators believe Audra Hadrath may have been taken by twenty year old Teresa Ochoa AKA Toby.  Described as a White/Hispanic female identifying as male, five feet four inches tall, one hundred eighty pounds with brown hair and brown eyes.  The two maybe traveling in a nineteen ninety nine Toyota four runner with Colorado license plate A F Q S nine two They are believed to be in Denver Metro area at this time. If you have any information regarding this abduction, immediately call 9 1  1.
